\section[(dialogue)]{Time and places — a first pass}

\label{lesson:SA-R99-first-pass-time-and-places}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a curtain and a lock.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a day, early evening, afternoon, midnight, dawn
  \item morning, twilight, early winter, late winter, autumn
  \item a moment, before, after, now, always
  \item ever, a delay, left, right; south, inside
  \item outside, above, below, in front, behind
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A day? (\textbf{\sk{अहः}}, \emph{ahaḥ}.) Early evening? (\textbf{\sk{प्रदोषः}}, \emph{pradoṣaḥ}.) Afternoon? (\textbf{\sk{अपराह्णः}}, \emph{aparāhṇaḥ}.) Midnight? (\textbf{\sk{मध्यरात्रिः}}, \emph{madhyarātriḥ}.) Dawn? (\textbf{\sk{उषः}}, \emph{uṣaḥ}.) Morning? (\textbf{\sk{प्रभातम्}}, \emph{prabhātam}.) Twilight? (\textbf{\sk{सन्ध्या}}, \emph{sandhyā}.) Early winter? (\textbf{\sk{हेमन्तः}}, \emph{hemantaḥ}.) Late winter? (\textbf{\sk{शिशिरः}}, \emph{śiśiraḥ}.) Autumn? (\textbf{\sk{शरद्}}, \emph{śarad}.) A moment? (\textbf{\sk{निमेषः}}, \emph{nimeṣaḥ}.) Before? (\textbf{\sk{पूर्वम्}}, \emph{pūrvam}.) After? (\textbf{\sk{पश्चात्}}, \emph{paścāt}.) Now? (\textbf{\sk{अधुना}}, \emph{adhunā}.) Always? (\textbf{\sk{सर्वदा}}, \emph{sarvadā}.) Ever? (\textbf{\sk{कदापि}}, \emph{kadāpi}.) A delay? (\textbf{\sk{विलम्बः}}, \emph{vilambaḥ}.) Left? (\textbf{\sk{वामः}}, \emph{vāmaḥ}.) Right; south? (\textbf{\sk{दक्षिणः}}, \emph{dakṣiṇaḥ}.) Inside? (\textbf{\sk{अन्तः}}, \emph{antaḥ}.) Outside? (\textbf{\sk{बहिः}}, \emph{bahiḥ}.) Above? (\textbf{\sk{उपरि}}, \emph{upari}.) Below? (\textbf{\sk{अधः}}, \emph{adhaḥ}.) In front? (\textbf{\sk{अग्रे}}, \emph{agre}.) Behind? (\textbf{\sk{पृष्ठतः}}, \emph{pṛṣṭhataḥ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Places, why and the house — a second pass}

\label{lesson:SA-R99-second-pass-places-why-and-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for in the middle and beside.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item in the middle, beside, everywhere, elsewhere, a street
  \item a main road, a crossroads, a corner, a library, a university
  \item an office, a restaurant, a station, a reason, because
  \item therefore, so, a cause, for that reason, because
  \item a bed, a pillow, a blanket, a curtain, a lock
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
In the middle? (\textbf{\sk{मध्ये}}, \emph{madhye}.) Beside? (\textbf{\sk{पार्श्वे}}, \emph{pārśve}.) Everywhere? (\textbf{\sk{सर्वत्र}}, \emph{sarvatra}.) Elsewhere? (\textbf{\sk{अन्यत्र}}, \emph{anyatra}.) A street? (\textbf{\sk{वीथी}}, \emph{vīthī}.) A main road? (\textbf{\sk{राजमार्गः}}, \emph{rājamārgaḥ}.) A crossroads? (\textbf{\sk{चतुष्पथः}}, \emph{catuṣpathaḥ}.) A corner? (\textbf{\sk{कोणः}}, \emph{koṇaḥ}.) A library? (\textbf{\sk{पुस्तकालयः}}, \emph{pustakālayaḥ}.) A university? (\textbf{\sk{विश्वविद्यालयः}}, \emph{viśvavidyālayaḥ}.) An office? (\textbf{\sk{कार्यालयः}}, \emph{kāryālayaḥ}.) A restaurant? (\textbf{\sk{भोजनालयः}}, \emph{bhojanālayaḥ}.) A station? (\textbf{\sk{स्थानकम्}}, \emph{sthānakam}.) A reason? (\textbf{\sk{कारणम्}}, \emph{kāraṇam}.) Because? (\textbf{\sk{यतः}}, \emph{yataḥ}.) Therefore? (\textbf{\sk{अतः}}, \emph{ataḥ}.) So? (\textbf{\sk{तस्मात्}}, \emph{tasmāt}.) A cause? (\textbf{\sk{हेतुः}}, \emph{hetuḥ}.) For that reason? (\textbf{\sk{तदर्थम्}}, \emph{tadartham}.) Because? (\textbf{\sk{यस्मात्}}, \emph{yasmāt}.) A bed? (\textbf{\sk{मञ्चः}}, \emph{mañcaḥ}.) A pillow? (\textbf{\sk{उपधानम्}}, \emph{upadhānam}.) A blanket? (\textbf{\sk{कम्बलः}}, \emph{kambalaḥ}.) A curtain? (\textbf{\sk{यवनिका}}, \emph{yavanikā}.) A lock? (\textbf{\sk{तालकम्}}, \emph{tālakam}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
